key_catalyst: Geopolitical escalation: U.S. strikes on Iran for ninth consecutive night pushing Brent crude above $90 and 30-year yield to 5%, reigniting inflation and rate-hike fears.
reasoning: Geopolitical escalation with Brent crude above $90 and 30-year yield breaking 5% poses a high threat to tech valuations, as seen in recent bearish responses on 2026-07-15 and 2026-07-16 when similar pressures led to QQQ declines. The market's pre-market optimism on earnings anticipation may underprice this escalating risk, which could catch up intraday or in subsequent sessions.
